scope: Vlog studio, six baked color presets/intensity, film-style morning/afternoon listing and exposed editing/comment controls. Includes previously local home personalization in this release.
attribution: CSSgram MIT: selected Reyes/Inkwell tone formulas adapted, no CSS-only export claim or third-party processing/upload service. Full notice distributed at /licenses/cssgram.txt.
pipeline: Local WebGL renderer -> canvas captureStream(24) -> MediaRecorder -> existing storage upload. Same rendered bitmap used for preview/record. Native-camera files validate duration and bake color before upload; unsupported/failing color paths never silently upload raw media.
guards: Countdown starts on MediaRecorder start event
Source/processed tracks, GL resources, timers, URLs and abort listeners cleaned up
Original remains available when color recording is unsupported
No database schema migration or old clip recoloring

browserValidation.environment: Chromium in-app browser; synthetic camera/media and in-memory storage/save adapters; no actual user camera or production mutation
checked: Top/bottom orientation against independent CPU reference
Motion differences between decoded frames at 0.5/1.5 seconds
Actual LogCapture selected tone/record/preview/text/save call flow
limitations: No native iOS Safari or physical Android camera/low-power testing
No production upload/partner playback mutation during QA
WebM MIME selection covered in unit tests but this browser encoded H264 MP4
Existing clips retain their baked pixels; changing color requires retaking
Source swatches are examples, not live camera thumbnails

releaseVerification: Recorded separately by checking GitHub Actions success and production version/assets after publishing.
